notes.title: TheHustleGame:End of TIME
notes.content:
After years of craftsmanship, the final PV of "HustleGame" is released and is now available on Steam!
(Steam store: Xuyu·The Way of Time https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871740)
The independent game "HustleGame" travels through the lights of the prosperous Tang Dynasty, the undercurrent of the Republic of China, the mountain fog of the 1990s, and the cyber neon. Six eras are intertwined, with more than 30 sub-levels, like a quicksand dream.
Parkour in the air, sword light to defeat the enemy, puzzle to clear the fog, the ancient rhyme of ink and wash and the cyber starlight blend to draw a picture of time.
Originated from the mist of Zhongnan, the descendants of Xuyu, stepped on the cracks of time and pursued the true meaning of the heart of Tao.
The black lotus of Xuanyangfang burned out, the electric arrows of Moshu split the sky, the fog of the Time Management Bureau gradually dissipated, and the battle with the Lord of Time was at the gate of destiny.
The three choices will eventually return to nothingness. Condensing the philosophical thoughts of ink and gathering the starlight from the cracks, composing Guangling San in a moment.
Invite you into the dream, explore the mystery of reincarnation, and return to oneness in a moment!
